headline: NVIDIA reports record third-quarter fiscal 2026 revenue
article_text: NVIDIA (NASDAQ: NVDA) reported record revenue of $57.0 billion for the third quarter of fiscal 2026, up 22% from the previous quarter and 62% from a year earlier. GAAP and non-GAAP gross margins were 73.4% and 73.6%, respectively. Diluted earnings per share were $1.30.
